propositions: Hand-maintained package help artifacts contain drift from true parser factory grammars (e.g., show.txt vs build_show(), list.txt vs build_list()), which must be eliminated by regenerating artifacts from canonical parser descriptions enriched with help= and epilog text.

Top-level help invocation and --help/-h tokens must be intercepted by a lexical pre-scan (pre_scan in _help_route.py) BEFORE operation/config/store/mount/parser-resolution boundaries, serving committed generated bytes deterministically.

Generate artifacts (one per canonical help key) with exact aliases reusing canonical bytes, compatibility/hidden spellings annotated with approved alias prog and replacement epilog, and deterministic rendering (UTF-8 LF, trailing newline, capitalized 'Usage:' prefix).

Grouped overview must list visible canonical commands once (no duplication), annotate exact aliases, omit hidden/retired routes, and validate grouped order/visibility via route registry; --check fails on blank command summaries and any missing/stale/stray/non-deterministic artifacts.

Factory enrichment in _parsers/core/ and _parsers/advanced/ must add per-argument help=, description/epilog text, and argparse.SUPPRESS directives so curated prose lives in parsers rather than hand-authored tables concatenated after generation.
Normal CLI execution negative control must still traverse the old execution ladder through operation composition and RP-04 mount/init boundaries after help pre-scan succeeds.
